what: On hover, the plate behind the button (stone · hand-cut paper) tilts in two jolts over .4s with no in-between values: first half 9°, second half −6°, ending at 0° (steps(1, end)). The cut-paper button stays at .5° until 49.9%, then at 50% snaps to −1.2° and stays tilted (linear). The arrow jumps 40% with no in-between values, .1s late (the paper button’s arrow is .16s late, moving up-right 25% · −25%). With look: fill, the plate switches to the accent color instantly.
ease: steps(1, end) — cuts between keyframes for a jolt (paper button cut at 49.9% and 50% on linear) · arrow only has a delay, no duration

options.[data-fx-part=plate]: Plate that tilts with a clunk (graphic behind the button — fill if svg=currentColor)
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: (If any) arrow that gets pushed out
options.--fx-r1: Front half tilt, default 9deg — cut-paper button .5deg
options.--fx-r2: Back half tilt, default -6deg — cut-paper button -1.2deg
options.--fx-r3: Tilt at the end, default 0deg — to leave it tilted, match --fx-r2 (-1.2deg)
options.--fx-ax: Arrow horizontal shift, default 40% — back button -40%
options.--fx-ay: Arrow vertical offset, default 0% — cut-paper button -25%
options.--fx-arrow-delay: Delay before the arrow rises, default .1s — cut-paper button .16s
options.look: fill: Switches the panel color to the accent color (--kf-accent)
options.--fx-ease: Plate curve, default steps(1, end) — cut-paper button linear (stays at --fx-r1 until 49.9%)
options.--fx-arrow-dur: Arrow duration, default 0s (as in the original, jumps right after the delay) — use .3s to make it slide

use: Your button text here · Cut-paper button: …

from.where: shared.css .c-btn (stone arrow button — stone 9°→−6°→0, arrow follows 40% after .1s) · .c-blankbtn·.f-line (hand-cut black button · contact button — .5°→−1.2° linear, turns green, arrow goes to the upper right after .16s)

note: Arrows are attached wrapped in a span, not directly as svg — the tool that measures % movement (motion-probe) reads the svg element size as 0
